resolvePortalCopyRequest(matterId, documentId, accessTier) is reached from the CLIENT portal action app.portal.tsx:151 where both documentId and accessTier are form-controlled. When accessTier==='full' it returns prisma.document.findUnique({where:{id:documentId}}) with no matterId/visibility scope, so a client can probe/lookup any firm document id (cross-tenant read, title leaked into notify/audit). Safe sibling resolvePortalSharedCopyRequest always scopes by matterId+visibility.

releaseMatterStaffer only role-checks (FIRM_ADMIN/ATTORNEY) despite the doc comment stating only the lead attorney or a firm admin may remove a staffer; the matter is access-checked but the selected staffUserId (removal target, e.g. the lead attorney) is never bound to the caller's authority, so any attorney assigned to a matter can delete the lead attorney's (or any staffer's) MatterAssignment and cut off their matter access.
Privileged mutation has no durable audit-log record, though this repository's own audit-log convention proves one exists and is reachable.

Loader calls fetchNoteRecord(noteId) after only requireUser(); fetchNoteRecord (permissions.server.ts:156) runs prisma.note.findUnique by id with no matter-scope or CLIENT visibility predicate, so any authenticated user can read any note (including INTERNAL privileged notes) on any matter by guessing/owning a note id. Safe sibling app.matters.$matterId.notes.$noteId.tsx uses fetchNoteForUser which scopes by matterAccessWhere.
